name: CheckAreaEntry
description: Internal derived-entry oracle for the Permissions system (Permissions V2/V4). Answers whether @userId may ENTER a feature area (@areaKey, e.g. runAdmin / kennelTools) on a surface (@surface bit: 1 = app, 2 = portal) for @kennelId: @allowed = 1 iff the user holds at least ONE capability in that area whose HC.PermissionFunction.Surfaces includes the surface and whose effective grant resolves to 1. The grant is the same tri-state rule CheckKennelPermission applies: HC.RolePermission kennel override (1 grant, -1 revoke, 0/absent inherit) over the global row, for every grantor the user holds — a MismanagementRoles bit ('mmRole'), an AppAccessFlags bit ('appFlag'), or 'hare' when @isHareOfEvent = 1. SuperAdmin (AppAccessFlags 0x40000000) bypasses everything. The legacy entry gates enterRunAdmin / enterKennelAdmin are excluded from the OR (transitional NOT IN; a no-op once those rows are deleted). Server-side twin of the client's canEnterArea(); used to gate the admin data sync SPs. NOT an API endpoint and does no auth of its own — the caller must already have authenticated the user. Returns nothing: the answer is the @allowed OUTPUT parameter.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The hasher whose entry is being tested. Required (no default).

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel the area belongs to. Grantor bits come from the user's live (removed = 0) HasherKennelMap row for this kennel; a user with no row holds no grantor and is refused unless SuperAdmin. Required (no default).

parameters.name: areaKey
parameters.description: Stable slug of the feature area (HC.PermissionFunction.AreaKey, NVARCHAR(40) NOT NULL since migration_permissions_v4_01). Required (no default).

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Surface bit: 1 = app, 2 = portal. Bit-tested against HC.PermissionFunction.Surfaces (SMALLINT bitmask, 3 = both). Required (no default).

parameters.name: allowed
parameters.description: OUTPUT: 1 = may enter the area, 0 = may not. Always set (1 for SuperAdmin, otherwise the EXISTS result).

parameters.name: isHareOfEvent
parameters.description: 1 when the caller is a designated hare of the event under consideration, so 'hare'-grantor capabilities count. Default 0. The caller derives it from HC.HasherEventMap.IsHare.

sideEffects: None. Read-only over HC.HasherKennelMap, HC.PermissionFunction, HC.PermissionRole and HC.RolePermission. No logging.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Lines 31-67 have no BEGIN TRY / BEGIN CATCH and no HC.ErrorLog write. The procedure is called by the admin sync SPs from OUTSIDE their own TRY blocks, so a runtime error here (e.g. a timeout on the permission join) reaches the client as a raw, unlogged 500. Internal helper, so the exposure is small, but CLAUDE.md says flag on sight.

@userId, @kennelId, @areaKey and @surface (lines 2-5) have no SQL default. The only callers are other HC6 SPs, so an omission is a developer error rather than a client-facing unlogged 500, but the house rule is that every parameter carries a default and is checked inside.

codeSmells.issue: Permission tables are not in db/schema/tables
codeSmells.detail: HC.PermissionFunction, HC.PermissionRole and HC.RolePermission are defined only by the archived migration scripts (db/hc6/app/archive/migration_permissions_v2_01_tables.sql, migration_permissions_v4_01_surfaces_areakey.sql). Column types in this contract were taken from those scripts.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
